observations: A vintage sewing machine on a wooden table.
The machine head is painted yellow and black with 'LION' visible on the front.
The table has a dark wood finish with visible wear and scratches.
The treadle stand is made of dark wood with a metal foot pedal base.
The machine is positioned in a domestic setting with curtains in the background.
A watermark 'DEBORAH FANIRAN' is present across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: Only one machine is shown in photo 0.
The table shown in photo 0 has a split design with a central support column.
No origin markings or stamps are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not sew or may have mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine sewing through fabric.

risks.risk: The motor may be seized or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the motor running and the machine moving the needle.

risks.risk: The table may have structural damage or loose joints.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the table joints and the underside.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential accessories like the bobbin case or foot pedal.
risks.proof: A photo of all included accessories.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric to demonstrate it works.
Close-up photos of the table joints and the underside to check for damage.
Photo of all included accessories like the foot pedal and bobbin case.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
